Fits 14-fm0000-series units built with the 2K IPS panel, such as the 14-fm0505sa. Because the 14-fm series covers both 2K IPS and 3K OLED builds, send us your full model number (e.g. 14-fm0505sa) or a photo of the sticker under your laptop on WhatsApp so we can confirm fit before dispatch. Supports laptop, tablet, tent and reverse modes. Tested before dispatch.

faqs.question: How do I know this is the right variant for my OmniBook X Flip 14-fm?
faqs.answer: The 14-fm series ships with two different touch panels: 2K IPS (this listing) and 3K OLED. Send us your full model number (e.g. 14-fm0505sa or 14-fm0003ni) or a photo of the label under your laptop on WhatsApp and we'll confirm which one you need before you order.

faqs.question: Is it touch screen?
faqs.answer: Yes, this is a multi-touch IPS panel with Corning Gorilla Glass 3 protection, matching the OmniBook X Flip's 2-in-1 laptop, tablet, tent and reverse modes.

faqs.question: What warranty comes with this screen?
faqs.answer: This screen carries a 3-month warranty against dead pixels and panel defects.
